{{Current events|year=2025|month=12|day=5|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes (2024–present)|Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes]]
**[[Afghanistan–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
***The [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] [[Afghan Armed Forces|military]] and [[Pakistan]]i [[Pakistan Armed Forces|military]] exchange fire along [[Durand Line|their border]], with Pakistani [[artillery]] targeting several [[Taliban]] outposts in the [[Helmand Province|Helmand]], [[Kandahar Province|Kandahar]], and [[Zabul Province|Zabul]] [[Provinces of Afghanistan|provinces]]. Both sides accuse the other of instigating the clashes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-afghanistan-exchange-heavy-fire-along-border-officials-say-2025-12-05/ (Reuters)] [https://wtop.com/world/2025/12/pakistan-and-afghanistan-trade-fire-along-the-border-but-no-casualties-are-reported/ (WTOP News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[War crimes during the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|War crimes during the Sudanese civil war]]
***Fifty people are killed, including 33 children, after the [[Rapid Support Forces]] strike a kindergarten in [[South Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/war-sudan-kordofan-drone-rsf-children-8fe0bb92a2db9977826be64f8a1119a2 (AP)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Colombia]] and the [[Clan del Golfo]] agree in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]], that the group's combatants will begin assembling in three designated zones in [[Chocó Department|Chocó]] and [[Córdoba Department|Córdoba]] starting March 1, with arrest and [[extradition]] orders suspended during the process. Colombia also designates additional [[Municipalities of Colombia|municipalities]] for pilot peace programs as part of broader negotiations aimed at reducing violence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombia-clan-del-golfo-crime-gang-agree-three-concentration-areas-combatants-2025-12-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[Tatmadaw]] conducts an airstrike on a tea shop in [[Sagaing]], [[Myanmar]], killing 18 civilians and wounding 20 more. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-army-resistance-bombing-football-match-d0017d296f587cfb4d299421de38943c (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. by Netflix]]
**[[Netflix, Inc.]] agrees to buy [[Warner Bros. Discovery]] for [[US$]]72 billion in one of the largest [[takeover]]s in entertainment industry history. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce91x2jm5pjo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A car strikes pedestrians during [[Christmas]] festivity preparations in [[Sainte-Anne, Guadeloupe|Sainte-Anne]], [[Guadeloupe]], [[France]], injuring 19 people, including seven children. [https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2025/12/06/guadeloupe-une-voiture-percute-un-food-truck-blessant-dix-neuf-pietons-dont-sept-enfants_6656224_3224.html (Le Monde)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Syria relations]], [[Terrorism in Canada]]
**[[Canada]] removes [[Syria]] from its list of [[State-sponsored terrorism|state sponsors of terrorism]] and [[Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham]] from [[List of organizations designated as terrorist by Canada|its list of terrorist entities]] following a review of the [[Syrian transitional government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canada-removes-syria-its-list-foreign-state-supporters-terrorism-2025-12-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Epstein files]]
**[[United States]] [[United States federal judge|federal judge]] [[Rodney Smith (judge)|Rodney Smith]] orders the release of [[Grand juries in the United States|grand jury]] records from the 2006–2007 investigations into [[Sexual abuse|sex offender]] [[Jeffrey Epstein]] and [[Sex trafficking|sex trafficker]] [[Ghislaine Maxwell]], ruling that the recently enacted [[Epstein Files Transparency Act]] supersedes federal grand jury secrecy rules. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/dec/05/federal-judge-epstein-grand-jury-materials (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Flood control projects scandal in the Philippines]]
**[[Philippines|Philippine]] [[President of the Philippines|president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] orders the [[Department of the Interior and Local Government|interior department]] and the [[Philippine National Police|national police]] to pursue contractor [[Sarah Discaya]] and others accused of involvement in a [[ghost project]] in [[Davao Occidental]]. [https://www.rappler.com/philippines/sarah-discaya-dpwh-officials-malversation-graft-cases-davao-ghost-project/ (Rappler)]
*The [[European Union]] fines social media platform [[Twitter|X]] {{Euro|link=yes}}120 million (US$140 million) for breaching the [[Digital Services Act]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/eu-imposes-120-million-fine-on-elon-musks-x-for-breaking-digital-rules/a-75033724 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Conscription in Germany]]
**The [[Germany|German]] [[Bundestag]] approves a [[Merz cabinet|government]] plan to expand [[Bundeswehr|military]] [[Military recruitment|recruitment]] through mandatory questionnaires and medical screenings for young men while keeping conscription suspended. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/german-parliament-backs-controversial-military-service-law-amid-russian-threat-2025-12-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Pensions in Germany]]
**The Bundestag approves a [[pension]]s bill that maintains pension levels until 2031 and introduces higher [[Taxation in Germany|tax-free]] earnings for retirees. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/german-parliament-vote-pensions-tests-merzs-authority-2025-12-05/ (Reuters)]
